headline: Highly Marelli Japan Corporation Engages Experts After Data Breach
body: Following a ransomware attack that resulted in the theft of proprietary information, Highly Marelli Japan Corporation is working with external cybersecurity experts to investigate the breach. The automotive components supplier confirmed unauthorized access to its systems but assured that its production operations were not disrupted. The company is focused on understanding the full scope of the incident and implementing measures to prevent future occurrences.
